category_edits.rationale: Scale each feed-forward residual contribution by 0.8 across all four category models while preserving attention residuals and existing GELU sublayers. Explicit forward execution preserves the same residual formula during training and inference. The predictor writer already imports BERT4RecModel from train.py, so it automatically loads the updated architecture with unchanged checkpoint shapes.

response.change_summary: Apply 0.8 feed-forward residual scaling to every BERT4Rec block across all four datasets, consistently in training and imported prediction architecture.
